parse.title: Fused Hero
parse.text:
Meta Unit
This unit is one of the most effective units in the game!

Overview

Fused Hero is a MythicalMythical unit. Hе can only be obtained by upgrading Carrot (Ultra) and Vego (Mage II) to when they get the fusion skill (upgrade 7 for both) and using the Fusion active skill with Carrot (Ultra) and Vego (Mage II). Takes both of their Traits, but will only take the initial units Level, Relics and stat alterations (ex. SSS ATK Carrot = SSS ATK Fused Hero).

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • This is the first unit who can achieve three traits or more.
  • You cannot place a new Carrot or Vego after forming a unique Fused Hero.
    • This effect only happens if Fusion is activated on the unit with unique on it
  • Double Unique is possible with Fused Hero if Carrot and Vego have the Unique trait.
    • This makes Quadruple Unique technically possible.
  • This units secondary damage type changes depending on the initial unit using the Fusion active, Carrot giving Fused Hero the Storm Damage Type and Vego giving the Light Damage Type.
  • You only need one of the fusion candidates to be a Shiny to form a Shiny Fused Hero.
